1 banana

1⁄4 cup chocolate chips

1⁄4 cup strawberry sauce

1⁄4 cup banana slices

1⁄4 cup marshmallows

1⁄4 cup whip cream

3 ounces vanilla ice cream

1 tsp toffee sauce
